note.title: Fed hikes 25bp - first increase since 2023
note.body: The FOMC raised the target range by 25 basis points on 16 September 2026, the first increase since 2023, and signalled one further hike this year. A downgraded dot plot at the next projection round would be the first sign the path is turning back.

note.title: BoJ lifts policy rate to 1.25%, a 31-year high
note.body: The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% on 18 September 2026, the highest level since 1995, with two board members dissenting. The dissents cap how quickly another step can follow, so a unanimous vote would signal the path is accelerating.
